observations: Photo 0 shows the front cover of a children's activity book titled 'First Look and Find' from Disney's Frozen. Characters Elsa and Anna are prominently featured, along with Olaf and other characters in scenes from the movie.

Photo 1 shows an open spread of the book with a 'Look and Find' puzzle. The scene includes Kristoff, Sven, Olaf, and various small creatures. A sidebar lists items to find, such as 'Kristoff's family in full hats'.

Photo 2 shows the back cover with text describing the book's features: 'Little ones can explore the pages all on their own', 'Look and Find play encourages focus and discovery', 'Puzzles boost problem-solving and logic skills'. It also includes publisher details: Phoenix International Publications, Inc., and copyright 2019 Disney Enterprises, Inc. Manufactured in China. ISBN 978-1-5027-7210-9 is visible.
A sticker on the front cover (photo 0) reads 'Kids Books ₦350' with a barcode and code 'P001370000055'.
